neutral.anchor_measurement: Assistant visual registration on the native raster, approximate scene anatomy; not automatic alpha-box centering or subpixel alignment metrology.
neutral.anchor_basis: Head with short upright mane/ears, short upright torso and feet; side tufted tail excluded from width; two hoof-foot support midpoint.
neutral.vertical_motion_policy: Consumer places this recorded anchor explicitly and designs any motion. No locomotion, ground shift or body normalization is inferred from this neutral PNG.

geometry_policy: Native pixels and adopted per-frame references retained. Atlas neutral coordinates are shifted only by the adopted crop origin.

taxonomy.verification_scope: Primary linked sources check the identity/selected diagnostic traits where listed; visual_traits are a concise original artistic brief, not a claim of exhaustive field-identification accuracy.
